neighbours.label: The bare word-start token ' h' when the tokenizer splits a word after its first letter ( h|ikers, h|obo, h|ound; also Arabic ' اله' and Cyrillic 'х' word starts); h-words whose first token is longer stay quiet
fire: The warden asked every hiker to sign the book at the hut.
Police kept the rival hooligans apart outside the stadium.
The children learned a hula dance during the holiday.
A troop of hussars rode through the town at dawn.
The farmer drove his hogs to market along the lane.
Two baying hounds followed the scent across the field.
The market was full of hagglers arguing over the price of rugs.
The ridge path is steep, and most hikers turn back at the lake.
quiet: The warden asked every hermit to sign the book at the hut.
Police kept the rival hippies apart outside the stadium.
The children learned a harvest dance during the holiday.
A troop of heralds rode through the town at dawn.
The farmer drove his heifers to market along the lane.
Two laughing hyenas followed the scent across the field.
The market was full of hazelnuts and baskets of dried figs.
The ridge path is steep, and most herons stay down by the lake.

notes: Card: peaks ' h' x14, ' اله' x6, ' H' x3. Probes: h|ikers 0.50, h|obo 0.44, h|ound 0.14; hotel, harbor, hedgehog, hamster (not split after h) 0.00. Tokenisation of the test words was checked without scoring: fire words start with the token ' h', near-miss words do not.
